# Paper 13: DPO (2023)

*Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model* · Module 4 — Scaling, adaptation and alignment · [Track on the site](https://arubad.github.io/AI_Research_Journey/#paper-13)

## Study approach
Derive Section 4 on paper: solve the KL-constrained reward maximization for $r(x, y) = \beta \log(\pi_\theta/\pi_{ref}) + \beta \log Z(x)$, plug into Bradley–Terry, watch $Z(x)$ cancel. Any LM is implicitly a reward model; RLHF becomes stable binary cross-entropy with no critic and no online sampling.
